evidence.flowerReq: Cauliflorous flowering on older wood; flowering only when temperatures are at or above 68°F (20°C). Drought stress causes flower drop.
evidence.fruitReq: Produces pods (drupes); flower to mature pod typically 5–7 months. Needs near year-round soil moisture; drought causes poor fruit production. Pollination may require compatible varieties or hand pollination where midges are absent.
